patents.abstract: Protein polyurethane alloys including one or more proteins dissolved within one or more polyurethanes. The protein polyurethane alloy may have one or more mechanical properties that are superior to the polyurethane in the absence of protein. The protein polyurethane alloys may be incorporated into a layered material including one or more protein polyurethane alloy layers.
patents.abstract_zh: 蛋白质聚氨酯合金，包括一种或多种溶解在一种或多种聚氨酯中的蛋白质。蛋白质聚氨酯合金可以具有在没有蛋白质的情况下优于聚氨酯的一种或多种机械性能。蛋白质聚氨酯合金可以掺入到包括一个或多个蛋白质聚氨酯合金层的层状材料中。

patents.title: A device for measuring the compression recovery properties of midsole materials
patents.title_zh: 一种测量中底材料压缩恢复特性的装置
patents.applicant: 李宁体育科技(北京)有限公司
patents.abstract: This application relates to the field of midsole material compression testing, and discloses a device for testing the compression recovery performance of midsole materials. The device includes a worktable with a testing component, comprising an optical rangefinder and a fixed platform. It also includes a clamping component, comprising a base plate, a pressure plate, a limiting screw, and a limiting screw plate, used for compressing the midsole material; and a locking component at the end of the clamping component, comprising a locking rod rotatably disposed at one end of the limiting screw. patents.abstract_zh: 本申请涉及中底材料压缩测试领域，公开了一种测试中底材料压缩恢复性能的装置。该装置包括带有测试组件的工作台，测试组件包括光学测距仪和固定平台；还包括夹持组件，用于压缩中底材料，由底板、压板、限位螺杆和限位螺杆板组成；以及位于夹持组件末端的锁紧组件，包括可转动地设置在限位螺杆一端的锁紧杆。

patents.title: Modular footwear and methods of making the same
patents.title_zh: 模块化鞋类及其制造方法
patents.abstract: Articles of footwear comprising modular parts. The modular parts can comprise a first part having a first surface and a second part having a second surface opposing the first surface. A first connector couples the first part to the second part and is integrally formed with the first part. A second connector couples the second part to the first part and is integrally formed with the second part. The first surface and the second surface are mated by the first connector and the second connector.
patents.abstract_zh: 一种包含模块化部件的鞋类物品。模块化部件可包括具有第一表面的第一部件和具有与第一表面相对的第二表面的第二部件。第一连接件将第一部件与第二部件连接，且与第一部件一体成型。第二连接件将第二部件与第一部件连接，且与第二部件一体成型。第一表面与第二表面通过第一连接件和第二连接件接合。
